label: Custom
notes: Custom is open-ended (e.g. Dental Clinic, Restaurant, Lighthouse) — the user names their own subcategory and rooms as free text instead of picking from a fixed list. Empty roomTypes/walkthroughOrder mean 'no predefined list, no preferred order' rather than 'none allowed'; the frontend falls back to free-text room entry and walkthrough order defaults to the room list's own order.
